summary: Frontend-only verification of the production-build fix (package.json start = 'next start -p 3000'). Verified via preview host (https://learning-hub-1067.preview.emergentagent.com) on desktop 1920 and mobile 390. RESULT: The production-build regression is FIXED — no MIME-type refusals, no 400/text-html chunks, no ChunkLoadError, no React #423/hydration errors. Linked CSS returns 200 text/css and JS chunk returns 200 application/javascript. All requested routes render 200 with expected content, hydration/interactivity confirmed (mega-menu, announcement dismiss, enquiry forms, mobile hamburger). One real defect found: header mega-menu links to /programs/ms-office-ai which 404s (data key is 'ms-office').

ui_bugs.issue: Link id 'ms-office-ai' (line 84) does not exist in programsData of app/(site)/programs/[programId]/page.js (key is 'ms-office'). /programs/ms-office-ai returns 404, and Next.js prefetch produces a console error: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 ()' for /programs/ms-office-ai?_rsc=...
Mobile menu toggle button has no data-testid (only aria-label='Toggle menu'). Not added by me because the preview now serves a compiled production build (no hot reload) — needs a rebuild.

issues: Inconsistent text alignment: 'Home', 'Franchise', 'Contact' are left-aligned while 'About', 'Programs', 'Resources', 'Careers' appear centered with their chevron pushed to the far-left edge — looks broken/misaligned

action_items: Fix broken program link: change Header.jsx id 'ms-office-ai' -> 'ms-office' (or add an 'ms-office-ai' entry / redirect). This is the ONLY 404 in the app and the only console error observed.
Add data-testid to the mobile menu toggle button in Header.jsx.
Fix mobile nav menu item alignment (expandable items centered vs plain links left-aligned).
Code review: app/(site)/programs/[programId]/page.js line ~748 hardcodes 'http://localhost:8001' as SERVER_API_BASE fallback — should fail fast / use env var only.
IMPORTANT for future edits: preview now runs `next start` (compiled build) so hot reload is OFF — any frontend change requires `yarn build` + `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` to appear.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx program id list and programsData keys are duplicated sources of truth for slugs — one already drifted (ms-office-ai). Derive nav items from a shared slug list (lib/programs-summary.js) to prevent 404s.
programs/[programId]/page.js is a very large file (>750 lines) with all program content inline; extract programsData to lib/ for maintainability.
Hardcoded localhost fallback for SERVER_API_BASE violates env-only config rule.
